title: Andrew Bond MD (WELL Health Chief Health Officer) applies Incorruptible to Canadian healthcare governance
summary: Dr. Andrew Bond — Chief Health Officer at TSX-listed WELL Health Technologies — publishes a long LinkedIn essay diagnosing Canadian healthcare's institutional-confidence crisis, and names Incorruptible as the governance-tool framework needed to rebuild. Positions Eric's work alongside Bent Flyvbjerg's on big-thing modularity.
blockquote: Eric Ries, who taught generations to innovate, has turned his attention to demonstrating what incorruptible governance practices look like for sustained innovation. These are the tools of institution building that meet the seriousness of the considerable lift ahead as we rebuild the foundations of healthcare in Canada to be sustainable and high-performing.
attribution_title: Chief Health Officer & Head of Public Sector, WELL Health Technologies (TSX: WELL)
